annotations.title: PDF annotations
annotations.writeHint: You will also see them in Chrome, Edge and other readers. The text does not change; it is written when you close a document, and you can always take them out.
annotations.writeUnconfirmed: Off until you confirm: turn it on to allow it for this library.
annotations.needsWrite: Turn on saving inside the PDFs first.
annotations.migrateHint: Write the highlights you already made into their PDFs, one file at a time.
annotations.migrateTitle: Write the existing highlights into the PDFs?
annotations.migrateSpace: A safety copy of each original is kept first: about {{size}}.
annotations.migrateSkipped_one: 1 document is skipped because it has highlights to check first.
annotations.migrateSkipped_other: {{count}} documents are skipped because they have highlights to check first.
annotations.author: Author in the PDF
annotations.authorHint: The PDF can leave your computer when you share it.
annotations.locationHint: Where the original of each changed PDF is kept. In the library data folder they are synced with it.
annotations.restoreBody: Each file goes back, byte for byte, to what it was before Research Lab wrote into it. Highlights stay in the app.
annotations.deleteBody_one: 1 copy will be deleted. A restore will then only cut the file back to its original bytes.
annotations.deleteBody_other: {{count}} copies will be deleted. A restore will then only cut each file back to its original bytes.
annotations.offBody_one: 1 PDF already has highlights written into it.
annotations.offBody_other: {{count}} PDFs already have highlights written into them.
annotations.failed: That could not be done. Nothing was changed in the PDFs.
